title: The Hunter's Sortie names three wolves — 'the charcoal ring, the clawed trunks, the leaning stones' — but only two ('clawed trunks'/gaunt wolf at Wolf Scrape, 'leaning stones'/ash wolf at Twin Stones) were ever found. A full loop of the Ashwood (Camp Smoke, Gray Cairn, Ashfall Clearing, Widow's Well, Herb Hollow, Sunken Shrine, Tower Shadow, the Last Trees) turned up no room matching 'the charcoal ring'; the quest stays permanently open with no further hook after both known wolves are reported.
